ConfigView.description: Read-only and redacted: names and switches, never a key, URL credential or token.
ConfigView.title: ConfigView

DecisionRow.description: What happened to one signal in one book (a ``SignalDisposition``).
DecisionRow.title: DecisionRow

Disposition.description: What one book did with one signal (plan M8.3).
Disposition.title: Disposition

ErrorBody.description: Every error response: generic, never echoing input or exception text.
ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody

Lineage.description: Everything recorded under a decision, plus its exits' decisions, in ``seq`` order.
Lineage.title: Lineage

StreamEnvelope.description:
Server → client. ``seq`` is set for stored events; ``type`` is the event type, or one of
``subscribed``, ``heartbeat``, ``resync``, ``summary``, ``quotes``, ``console``, ``stopped``,
``error``.
StreamEnvelope.title: StreamEnvelope

StreamSubscribe.description: Client → server: (re)subscribe; stored events after ``since_seq`` are replayed first.
StreamSubscribe.title: StreamSubscribe
